_comment: Copy this to eval.config.local.json and point it at YOUR install. That copy
is gitignored, so a real hostname and a real key lookup never land in a
public repo.
NO SECRET IS STORED HERE. admin_key_command is an argv array executed
directly, never through a shell, so this file cannot smuggle in a command
substitution. Prefer admin_key_env on a machine with no keychain: set the
named variable and leave the command out.
profile is smoke by default. Use --profile onboarding after the private
Golden 20 is complete. It requires its full question mix, clean refusals,
strong evidence coverage, low duplicate waste, and declared answer checks.
Use --profile release only after your private
suite has at least 60 reviewed cases and every declared release slice has
at least 5 cases. That gate is structural v1 retrieval coverage, not full
v2 answer, citation, corpus-completeness, or security certification. Release
derives query-kind from kind and requires every unanswerable refusal to run;
--no-think is smoke-only.
A private mode-0600 corpus contract can add deterministic source-inventory
gates. Set corpus_contract to its path and installation_ref to the same
client slug used by that contract. Neither value belongs in this template.
rerank and graph_boost are OFF here on purpose. A ranking that changes
between two identical runs cannot answer whether a change helped. Measure
them as variants:  node eval/run.mjs --rerank --graph-boost
